participating-org.narrative:
Vision: To create a self-sustaining generation of the intersex community in Coast Kenya.
Mission: Empowering the intersex community out of social marginalization, isolation, and discrimination through empowerment, capacity building, and advocacy for self-determination.
Objectives:
Build capacity among intersex youth as skilled advocates and leaders who can effectively influence policy and shape inclusive practices Reduce stigma and discrimination through comprehensive community education reaching families, religious leaders, healthcare providers, and educational institutions Influence county and national policy to include intersex protections, legal recognition, and comprehensive anti-discrimination measures Provide peer support networks and safe spaces for intersex youth with mentorship and psychosocial support Advance Sexual and Reproductive Health Rights (SRHR) ensuring intersex persons receive appropriate healthcare services without discrimination Promote economic empowerment initiatives that support the independence and self-sufficiency of intersex individuals Foster social inclusion creating supportive communities where intersex individuals can thrive with dignity
Values:
Youth Leadership: Intersex young people with lived experience lead all decision-making, advocacy, and implementation Community Empowerment: Building collective power through peer networks and self-determination rather than dependency Human Rights and Social Justice: Recognizing intersex rights as fundamental human rights requiring urgent action Inclusivity and Non-Discrimination: Celebrating intersex identities and challenging harmful norms that demand conformity Bodily Autonomy: Opposing non-consensual surgeries and affirming that intersex bodies are natural, valid, and worthy of autonomy Transparency and Accountability: Participatory monitoring ensures accountability to community priorities Solidarity and Intersectionality: Integrating intersex advocacy within broader social justice movements ILICK (also operating as IRIC-K) has operated since 2022 in Kilifi County with 6 dedicated staff including experienced community organizers, advocacy coordinators, and intersex youth leaders bringing lived expertise. We have successfully organized the Ushindi Retreats providing safe spaces for the Muslim queer community, conducted community awareness campaigns reaching hundreds of coastal residents, and built strong networks with healthcare providers, youth organizations, and government stakeholders.
